title: 第四章 珍宝阁
content_zh:
周围众人脸上尽是震撼，眼前这个被他认为是骗子的少年，确实是有点能耐。

    “原来如此！我就觉得那老鬼没安什么好心。”老妇若有所思，喃喃自语道。

    “这是我身上全部的金币，如若不够我回府再给您去取，求公子救救我奶娘。”叶雪妍赶紧从储物袋中取出了金币，足有两千金币，她将这些金币装在另一个空的储物袋中，一股脑的递到任天一面前，激动的说道。

    任天一接过储物袋在手中掂了掂说道：“姑娘只需要找到三种草药，龙筋藤、金丝串钱花、融绒草，等量炼化，提取药液，每日早中晚服用三次，每次一口，半月即可痊愈。”

    “等等，侯某在古籍上见到过噬脉蛊的介绍，传闻这种蛊只存在于数千年前，如今早已绝迹，况且他说的这几种药材几乎遍地都是，叶姑娘不要被他骗了。”此时侯执事仍认为认天一是在胡诌，忍不住的开口道。

    叶雪妍闻言，眉头微皱，将疑惑的眼神看向任天一。

    “也罢，按照此方子服药，若不见好转，随时来任府找我。”任天一说着就想离去，却被那侯执事挡道了去路。

    “任府？我叶家和任家也是有些交情的，怎么公子面孔如此陌生，不知公子怎么称呼？”此时，叶雪妍也是满脸的狐疑之色。

    “你告诉他们！”任天一从人群中揪出石头，对他吩咐道。

    此时，石头满脸尴尬，见实在躲不过去，这才讪讪说道：“这位是就是任府六公子，任天一。”

    “哗！”

    众人哗然，不少人摇头叹息，本以为碰到了位天才，谁知竟是个傻子！

    “果然是在胡诌！”

    “听闻任府有七子，唯有六公子是个傻子，你就是那傻子？”

    “任天一，傻六？”
content_en:
The faces of everyone around him were full of shock. The young man in front of him, whom he thought was a liar, was indeed quite capable.

    "That's it! I don't think that old ghost has any good intentions." The old woman murmured to herself thoughtfully.

    "This is all the gold coins I have. If there are not enough, I will go back to my house to get them for you. Please save my nanny." Ye Xueyan quickly took out the gold coins from the storage bag, which contained two thousand gold coins. She put these gold coins in another empty storage bag and handed them to Ren Tianyi one by one, saying excitedly.

    Ren Tianyi took the storage bag, weighed it in his hand and said, "The girl only needs to find three kinds of herbs, dragon tendon vine, golden string money flower, and velvet grass, refine them in equal amounts, extract the medicinal liquid, and take it three times a day in the morning, noon and evening, one mouthful each time, and she will be cured in half a month."

    "Wait a minute, Hou has seen an introduction to the Vein Devouring Gu in ancient books. It is rumored that this kind of Gu only existed thousands of years ago and is now extinct. Moreover, the medicinal materials he mentioned are almost everywhere. Miss Ye, don't be fooled by him." At this time, Deacon Hou still thought Tianyi was telling nonsense and couldn't help but said.

    Hearing this, Ye Xueyan frowned slightly and looked at Ren Tianyi with doubtful eyes.

    "Forget it, take the medicine according to this prescription. If you don't get better, come to Ren Mansion to find me at any time." As soon as Ren Tian said this, he wanted to leave, but was blocked by Na Hou Deacon.

    "Ren Mansion? My Ye family and Ren family also have some friendship. Why is the young master's face so strange? I wonder what he is called?" At this time, Ye Xueyan also had a look of suspicion on her face.

    "Tell them!" Ren Tianyi pulled out a stone from the crowd and ordered him.

    At this time, Shitou's face was full of embarrassment. Seeing that he couldn't escape, he said sarcastically: "This is Ren Tianyi, the sixth young master of Ren Mansion."

    "Wow!"

    Everyone was in an uproar, and many people shook their heads and sighed. They thought they had met a genius, but they turned out to be a fool!

    "It's true that you are talking nonsense!"

    "I heard that there are seven sons in the Ren family, but only the sixth son is a fool. Are you that fool?"

    "Ren Tianyi, Silly Liu?"
